facts.text: Torresdale’s historic landmark welcomes visitors with free admission and First Friday openings, celebrating the neighborhood’s rich cultural heritage.
Philadelphia, founded in 1682 by Quaker William Penn, was the colonial capital and birthplace of the Declaration of Independence.
The city boasts 67 National Historic Landmarks, including Independence Hall, making it the third‑most in any U.S. city.
Walnut Street Theatre, founded in 1809, is the oldest continuously operating theatre in the English‑speaking world and a National Historic Landmark.
Reading Terminal Market, established in 1893, remains a historic food market and National Historic Landmark housed in the original terminal building.
Philadelphia uniquely fields teams in all four major U.S. sports leagues: the Phillies, Eagles, Flyers, and 76ers.
